steps: 1. Season the chicken thighs well and cook in sesame oil on both sides until slightly charred. Deglaze the pan with some lime juice / water and cook your Pak Choi until soft and then set aside.
2. In the same pan, add the chicken broth (slightly scrape the bottom of the pan if there are leftover bits), lime juice, ginger, spring onion and lemongrass and simmer for 5-8 minutes.
3. Add cooked rice, chicken thighs, Pak Choi and garnish to a bowl and carefully pour the broth on top (do this at the very end just before you’re about to eat!)
title: Chicken Brothy Rice
description: That type of go - to meal you think of when you need something cosy, comforting and if you're feeling a little under the weather!
